settings.mail_welcome_body:
Hello {fname},

{owner_name} has set up a private Trilivy demo for {company}. It is yours for {days} days, until {expires}.

Choose your password here (the link works for {link_hours} hours):
{link}

Then sign in at {host}. Good first steps:
- Ask the assistant about the sample company's HR and IT policies (try: "My VPN keeps disconnecting, what should I do?").
- Upload two or three of your own documents under My documents, and ask about them.
- Click anything that looks interesting, including the greyed items: each one explains what it does in the full platform.

To send us a message at any time, use Contact us inside the demo.

The Trilivy team
settings.consent_html:
This is a guided demo of Trilivy. To help our team understand what is useful to you, we record your activity here: pages you open, features you click, the questions you ask and the answers you get, documents you upload, and your IP address.

Only Trilivy staff see this. It is deleted at the latest 30 days after your demo ends, and earlier if you ask (send a message with Contact us).

Please do not upload other people's personal data or secrets. Files you upload are used only inside your private demo and are deleted with it.
settings.mail_ended_body:
Hello {fname},

Thank you for trying Trilivy. Your demo has ended, and everything you uploaded will be deleted on {purge_date}.

To talk about a pilot on your own data, reply to {owner_email}.

The Trilivy team
